notes: An older build's own self-tests briefly borrowed your saved character while they ran; a crash at the wrong moment could leave it set aside instead of put back. The game now restores it for you automatically the next time you play.
And if it ever cannot (a locked file, say), it will tell you and refuse to start a fresh character over the top — your original is never overwritten. Nothing you have made is thrown away.
title: Your character is safe
